Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry

Yield: 2 servings

Ingredients
- 12 ounces boneless chicken breast
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 red bell pepper
- 2 cups broccoli florets
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch
- 3 tablespoons water
- 2 cups cooked rice

Preparation
1. Stir the cornstarch into the water and the soy sauce.
2. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat until it smokes.
3. Stir-fry the chicken 4 minutes, until browned.
4. Add the pepper, broccoli and garlic and stir-fry 3 minutes.
5. Pour in the sauce, tossing until glossy. Serve over the rice.
